content:
If you like the new wallpapers Apple has designed for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use them—you can download them right here right now.

Download the new iPhone 18 Pro wallpapers

Although the default iOS wallpapers are dynamic and respond to the device's motion and gestures, what we have below are static images captured directly from the first iOS 27 candidate build.

The candidate build does not appear to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so we may have to wait a few more weeks, possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to click on the image to download the full-resolution wallpaper, then set it as your background through the Photos app or the Settings app (if you're using an iOS device).
